text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PROMETHEUS_SCRAPE_FAILURE - missing metrics: "redwood.api.requests_total" in prod region-us-west. Severity: P2. Pager: ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: paging priya (primary). PD link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/INC12345 :pager:

Priya: on it, grabbing dashboards. Noted increased scrape errors across prometheus-targets-prod.

Alex: seeing log-ingest backpressure in `kafka-ingest-cluster` too — consumer lag jumping for topic `raw-logs-prod` partitions 4-7. Might be related.

Priya: hmm, if exporters aren't scrapping, some autoscalers may scale to zero incorrectly. Can someone check `prometheus-prod` scrape job logs?

Marco: tailing prometheus: ```level=warn ts=2026-03-14T07:05:12Z caller=scrape.go:900 component=scrape job=redwood-exporters target=http://10.12.8.42:9100/metrics msg="read failed" err="dial tcp 10.12.8.42:9100: connect: connection refused"```

Jin: that IP is node-exporter on node gpu-7. I see kubelet crashed on that node earlier, kube-proxy restarted. Nodes still ready?

Marco: gpu-7 is NotReady for 7m. `kubectl get nodes` shows `gpu-7 NotReady`. Containers on that node include `node-exporter` and a small exporter we run for Redis.

Priya: priority: get scrapes back. If exporters are down, prometheus will mark metrics missing and any alerting based on them will flip. For now we should silence noisy PD pages and focus on mitigation.

ops-oncall: I silenced PROMETHEUS_SCRAPE_FAILURE on PD for 30m while we mitigate.

Alex: quick mitigation plan: 1) try `kubectl cordon gpu-7` + drain and restart kubelet; 2) scale up `prometheus-scrape` job replicas to cover new scrape load; 3) if kafka consumers stuck, force-restart the affected consumer group.

Priya: agree. Marco, can you attempt node restart / kubelet restart? Alex, can you patch prometheus scrape config to temporarily fallback to alternate exporter IPs? Jin, please check if this impacts any autoscalers (especially the inference autoscaler).

Marco: running: ```ssh core@gpu-7 'sudo systemctl restart kubelet && sudo reboot'``` — kubelet came back, node transitioned to Ready at 07:18:09 but node-exporter kept crashing (OOMKilled). Looking at dmesg: `Out of memory: kill process 1122 (node-exporter) score 987`

Jin: why is node-exporter OOMing? Did something schedule heavy jobs on that node? gpu workloads maybe spilled?

Priya: check pods on node: `kubectl get pods -o wide --all-namespaces --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-7`

Marco: there are 3 large customer workloads pinned (batch-inference jobs) plus kube-system pods. One batch job spiked mem to 92%. I evicted the two best-effort batch pods. Node-exporter restarted cleanly after eviction. Scrapes for that target resumed at 07:21:02.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 acknowledged by Priya.

Priya: confirmed `redwood.api.requests_total` is now present on prometheus: `promql: changes(redwood_api_requests_total[5m])` returns data. Good. Next: check kafka consumer lag and log ingestion backlog.

Alex: consumer lag still high. Running: ```kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-prod:9092 --describe --group raw-logs-consumers``` shows LAG sum ~ 3.2M messages. Consumers are in Running state but one pod `log-ingest-3` showing high GC and CPU.

Jin: that pod is on the same node pool as those batch-inference jobs — double impact. I propose scaling `log-ingest` to +3 replicas and force rolling restart of `log-ingest-3`.

ops-oncall: scaling now: `kubectl scale deployment/log-ingest --replicas=9 -n infra` -> success.

Marco: restarting `log-ingest-3` pod: `kubectl delete pod log-ingest-3 -n infra` — new pod came up on different node. Consumer lag started decreasing slowly.

Priya: good, keep monitoring lag and 5xx rates. Any customer-facing errors? Our frontend alert shows slight bump in 5xx for API routes between 07:00-07:25.

Alex: checking apigateway logs: ```curl 'https://logs.internal/api?query=5xx_count&from=1700000000&to=1744002500'``` returned increased 5xx tied to autoscaler flips — some backends scaled down because metrics were missing. Affected customers: cust-alpha (low volume), cust-gamma (high). I'll open support ticket format.

Priya: note for postmortem: autoscaler should not scale to zero for backends on missing metrics alone. We should add a grace period and fallback to request-based scaling.

Jin: customers notified?

Alex: I filed a short incident message for SRE -> support channel and pinged CS to notify cust-gamma. Message: "We observed temporary API errors 07:00-07:25 due to Prometheus scrape disruption and log-ingest lag. Core services restored; we are validating no data loss. Updates to follow."

ops-oncall: PD escalated to secondary after 10m unacked, but Priya acked at 07:23 and held. PagerDuty notes attached.

Priya: current status: scrapes recovered, node-exporter stable, log-ingest replicas scaled, consumer lag decreasing (from 3.2M to 1.1M in 24m). Prometheus alert rate falling. I'm handing off to Alex for cleanup and RCA draft.

Alex: taking over. Next steps: 1) let consumers catch up and monitor until lag < 100k; 2) revert temporary scrape fallback config after 1h; 3) produce RCA and mitigation items (autoscaler change, node pod eviction policy, monitoring for large batch jobs pinned to gpu nodes).

Marco: will add kube eviction policy and node allocatable checks to infra runbook.

Jin: I'll include change to autoscaler behavior in the eval.

Priya: thanks team. If lag stalls or 5xx persists, re-open PD. Closing thread for now — leaving the PD silence until we're fully green. :white_check_mark:

Alex: quick paste of commands used (for runbook): ```# check node status kubectl get nodes -o wide; # evict pods kubectl delete pod <pod> -n <ns> --grace-period=30; # restart kubelet ssh core@<node> 'sudo systemctl restart kubelet' # kafka consumer check kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-prod:9092 --describe --group raw-logs-consumers```

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status: Mitigated -> monitoring.

Priya: last check 07:58 — consumer lag 72k, API 5xx back to baseline. I'll file RCA ticket and link here.

Alex: thx — handing to RCA owner Priya.

Priya: RCA ticket created: RDW-INC-20260314-123 (will add timelines and follow-ups).
